title: 延迟盘中更新：油债冲击压低风险偏好，金融改革与港股公告提供结构性线索 + 美股盘前：期指约涨0.5%，油价回落仍破百；ORCL强势，ADBE与MKSI遭负反馈
summary: 截至09:40 CST核验，隔夜美股与亚洲早盘承压，油价和长债收益率抬高估值门槛；国内金融改革、科技金融工具与港股公司事件提供结构性线索。今日AKShare快照未到、双排行受403限制，均显式降级；重点个股按条件关注与回避分层展示。 道指、标普500和纳指100期货在美东6:58分别约涨0.55%、0.53%和0.60%；Brent回落3.21%至约104.18美元，10年期美债收益率仍约4.94%。ORCL财报后盘前涨约6%—7%，NVDA、RH与SOBO走强；ADBE、MKSI、AFG和KR只作风险观察。20:34 CST回读时BLS公开CPI当前版仍为7月，未用预期冒充实际值。

9月10日旧快照

关键词云图

油价冲击长债高位亚洲承压科技金融长期资金芯片回撤国产AI芯片港股摊薄地产股息消费走弱智算服务器排行降级
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
地缘
油价再涨，供应风险压过风险资产修复
Reuters于9月11日称Brent约109.26美元、较前一日再升约3.35美元；中东与红海运输风险抬高通胀和成本门槛，油气上游相对受益，航空、运输和高耗能制造承压。
政策
央行发布金融强国“十五五”规划与配套行动
中国人民银行9月10日19:47发布国新办答问：金融强国规划及央行改革发展规划已印发，并配套9项行动方案；政策强调逆周期调节、利率市场化与人民币基本稳定。
政策
科技金融工具扩容，资本市场改革继续推进
央行提出下调结构性工具利率、增加科技创新与设备更新再贷款额度并完善科技债券风险分担；证监会同时强调长期资金、并购重组、分红回购和多层次市场改革。
产业
HBM紧缺推高国产AI芯片报价
Reuters援引供应链人士称，华为Ascend 950DT报价较两个月前高20%—50%，寒武纪新一代690高20%—30%。涨价利好上游议价，但也反映供给瓶颈和客户采购成本上升。
海外科技
美股科技板块回撤，A/H映射先看承接
9月10日标普500、纳指和道指分别跌0.58%、0.65%和0.60%；Nvidia跌2.3%、Micron跌4.7%，Apple逆势涨3.6%。半导体与AI链不宜仅凭叙事追高。
港股并购
远见控股拟购3.8亿元智算服务器
HKEX公告显示公司拟购买逾100台Nvidia GPU服务器，代价人民币3.8亿元；交易仍需股东批准，付款、交付和此前大额服务器订单共同抬高执行与资金风险。
港股融资
金斯瑞配售净筹约23.27亿港元
金斯瑞拟以30.50港元配售7712.6万股，较9月10日收盘折让4.7%，占扩大后股本约3.38%；资金主要投向AIDD产能与研发。9月11日09:20报价33.06港元、涨3.31%；09:50回读仍无更新，正反馈现时性不足且摊薄风险仍在。
港股业绩
新鸿基地产利润与股息增长，开盘反馈偏弱
2025/26年度基础利润228.50亿港元、股东应占利润214.26亿港元，全年股息3.91港元、增4%。但9月11日09:20报价110.20港元、跌5.57%，结果利好尚未获得价格确认。
港股经营
裕元与宝胜8月收入继续走弱
裕元8月收入同比跌2.1%、首八月跌3.1%；宝胜8月收入同比跌9.0%、首八月跌4.0%。消费与制造订单尚未形成一致改善信号。
港股业绩
英皇文化预告由巨亏转为微利
公司预计年度净利润不多于300万港元，前一年亏损1.416亿港元；影院收入改善与减值拨回贡献明显，扭亏方向正面但盈利规模和一次性因素限制外推。
港股事件
上实城市开发研究保障房REIT及资产处置
公司称方案仍处探索阶段，可能采用REIT、直接出售或其他方式，且受审批与市场条件约束；这是资产盘活线索，不是已完成交易。

美股夜盘行情总结

指数
延迟现货代理
SPY -0.58%、QQQ -1.07%、DIA -0.63%均为9月10日美股现金时段延迟代理，不是实时夜盘期指；09:20 CST复核。
对照
行业/概念确认不可得
夜盘/期指：SPY -0.58%、QQQ -1.07%、DIA -0.63%为9月10日现金时段延迟代理，行情时点约08:00 CST、09:20抓取，非实时期指。Moomoo行业、Futunn Sparks及规则允许的一次Moomoo Sparks回退均返回HTTP 403；未沿用旧行，无法形成确认/背离/潜在反转判定。
映射
油债信号优先于缺失排行
隔夜芯片回落与油价、利率上行映射为A/H成长、航空和运输压力；只有本地盘中价格与宽度改善才能推翻该信号。

盘中结论

事实：这是延迟盘中更新，不是开盘前预测。上证指数09:47跌1.62%，恒生指数09:34跌1.46%。

判断：科技金融与资本市场改革构成中期托底，但油价、长债收益率和隔夜芯片回落主导短线风险信号。

不确定性：9月11日AKShare刷新尚未到达，美股两组排行均受阻，本地宽度与板块确认缺失。

重点个股推荐

状态说明：以下卡片为条件状态，不是即时买入指令；行情均按最近可核验时间披露。

金斯瑞生物科技HK.01548
条件关注

事实与状态：公司以30.50港元配售7712.6万股，净筹约23.27亿港元用于AIDD产能、研发及一般企业用途；Google Finance最近可核验报价为32.98港元、+3.06%，时间10:12:06 CST。

确认条件：维持30.50港元配售价之上，同时成交持续、相对生物科技板块不转弱。

风险与失效：扩大后股本摊薄约3.38%；若跌破配售价或配售卖压持续，观察逻辑失效。

寒武纪SH.688256
条件关注

事实与状态：Reuters报道HBM短缺背景下国产AI加速器报价上调；Google Finance最近可核验报价为1,034.56元、-0.89%，时间09:59:22 CST，负面价格反馈未形成看多确认。

确认条件：股价转正并相对本地芯片同业走强，同时供应链信息得到进一步核实。

风险与失效：报道依赖匿名供应链来源，HBM约束也可能抬高投入成本；若弱势扩大或涨价不能转化为订单与利润，观察逻辑失效。

新鸿基地产HK.00016
回避

事实与状态：2025/26年度基础利润228.50亿港元、股东应占利润214.26亿港元，全年股息3.91港元、同比增4%；但Google Finance最近可核验报价113.20港元、-3.00%，时间09:20:13 CST。

重新观察条件：价格企稳并重新站上开盘区间，且相对香港地产板块转强。

风险与失效：业绩与股息利好遭明显负面价格反馈；持续跑输时不应包装为多头候选。

裕元集团HK.00551
回避

事实与状态：公司公告8月收入同比下降2.1%，首八月制造业务收入同比下降5.0%，经营证据本身偏弱；当日可靠报价未取得，最近可访问报价仍为9月10日16:08:42 CST的13.09港元。

重新观察条件：月度收入恢复同比增长，并由后续可靠行情验证承接。

风险与失效：若收入继续收缩，消费与制造订单改善逻辑不成立；缺少当日报价不改变该负面经营判断。

板块轮动看板

相对受益

油气上游与政策支持的金融基础设施，仍需本地价格确认。

观察方向

科技金融、AI服务器与资本市场服务，等待宽度和持续成交。

压力方向

半导体、航空运输及摊薄港股同时受油价、利率或融资压力。

验证信号

上证/恒指宽度、芯片相对强弱、Brent、美债10年期与开盘后量能。

逻辑链

油价与地缘风险 → 通胀门槛上升 → 成长、航空和运输承压。
美股芯片回落 → A/H半导体映射 → 本地相对强势前不升级。
央行/证监会改革 → 融资支持与长期资金 → 需看信贷和成交传导。
港股公告 → 公司催化与摊薄并存 → 由价格反馈决定是否纳入。

风险雷达

油价与地缘

供应中断或缓和都可能快速反转板块领导。

利率

美债10年期收益率接近5%，抬高高久期资产估值门槛。

负面价格反馈

新鸿基地产与金斯瑞未因表面利好获得开盘确认。

证据时效

最新AKShare文件为9月10日，不能代表9月11日宽度。

排行降级

两组美股排行均遭HTTP 403，未用旧行替代。

数据来源与时间点

延迟盘中更新，证据截止2026-09-11 09:40 CST。国内发现源：金十、财联社与证券时报于09:43 CST检索；未回到原始页的条目未写入。来源：央行/国新办9月10日19:47发布会；Reuters全球市场、国产AI芯片与9月10日美股收盘；HKEX自9月10日收盘至截止点公告，台账枚举250条、38条必审项全部决策。Google Finance：上证09:47跌1.62%、恒指09:34跌1.46%；新鸿基地产110.20港元/-5.57%、金斯瑞33.06港元/+3.31%，报价时间均09:20、09:50回读仍无更新。AKShare v1.18.94 fetchedAt=2026-09-10 12:44:34 CST、status=ok、marketPhase=intraday_snapshot，但对9月11日已过期；9月10日A股涨/跌/平1117/4283/154、中位-1.078%，港股562/1142/1094、中位0%，仅作前一日背景。夜盘/期指：SPY -0.58%、QQQ -1.07%、DIA -0.63%为9月10日现金时段延迟代理，行情时点约08:00 CST、09:20抓取，非实时期指。Moomoo行业、Futunn Sparks与Moomoo Sparks于09:28均返回HTTP 403，未取得排行行或代表股实时对照。

PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 indicate heat/importance, not price change.
Major News
Geopolitics
Oil rises again as supply risk overwhelms risk-asset relief
Reuters reported Brent near $109.26 on September 11, up about $3.35 on the day. Middle East and Red Sea shipping risks raise inflation and cost hurdles, relatively supporting upstream oil while pressuring airlines, transport and energy-intensive manufacturing.
Policy
PBOC releases the 15th Five-Year financial-power plan and actions
In a briefing published at 19:47 CST on September 10, the PBOC said the financial-power plan and its own reform plan had been issued with nine action programs, emphasizing countercyclical policy, market-based rates and basic RMB stability.
Policy
Technology-finance tools expand as capital-market reform advances
The PBOC outlined lower rates and larger quotas for structural tools, plus improved risk sharing for technology bonds. The CSRC highlighted long-term capital, M&A, dividends, buybacks and multi-level market reform.
Industry
HBM scarcity lifts quoted prices for Chinese AI chips
Reuters cited supply-chain sources saying Huawei Ascend 950DT quotes were 20%–50% above two months earlier and Cambricon's next-generation 690 was 20%–30% higher. Pricing power is positive upstream but also signals supply constraints and higher customer costs.
US Tech
US technology retreats; A/H mapping requires price confirmation
On September 10 the S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow fell 0.58%, 0.65% and 0.60%. Nvidia dropped 2.3% and Micron 4.7%, while Apple rose 3.6%. Semiconductor and AI exposure should not be chased on narrative alone.
HK M&A
Envision Green proposes an RMB380m AI-server purchase
An HKEX filing says the company plans to buy more than 100 Nvidia GPU servers for RMB380m. Shareholder approval, payment and delivery conditions, and an earlier large server order raise execution and funding risks.
HK Financing
GenScript placement targets about HK$2.327bn net proceeds
GenScript plans to place 77.126m shares at HK$30.50, a 4.7% discount to the September 10 close and about 3.38% of enlarged capital, mainly for AIDD capacity and R&D. At 09:20 CST on September 11 it was HK$33.06, up 3.31%; a 09:50 readback had no newer timestamp, so positive feedback lacked current confirmation while dilution risk remained.
HK Results
SHKP raises profit and dividends, but opening feedback is weak
FY2025/26 underlying profit was HK$22.850bn, attributable profit HK$21.426bn and the full-year dividend HK$3.91, up 4%. Yet at 09:20 CST on September 11 the shares were HK$110.20, down 5.57%, so the result lacked price confirmation.
HK Operations
Yue Yuen and Pou Sheng report softer August revenue
Yue Yuen's August revenue fell 2.1% year over year and eight-month revenue fell 3.1%. Pou Sheng's August and eight-month revenue fell 9.0% and 4.0%. Consumer demand and manufacturing orders have not improved in unison.
HK Results
Emperor Culture guides from a large loss to a small profit
The company expects annual net profit of no more than HK$3m versus a HK$141.6m loss a year earlier. Better cinema revenue and impairment reversals helped, but the small profit and one-off component limit extrapolation.
HK Event
Shanghai Industrial Urban explores rental-housing REIT options
The company says the plan remains exploratory and could involve a REIT, direct sale or other route, subject to approvals and market conditions. It is an asset-recycling watch item, not a completed transaction.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Index
Delayed cash-session proxies
SPY -0.58%, QQQ -1.07% and DIA -0.63% were delayed September 10 cash-session proxies, not live overnight futures; quotes were checked at 09:20 CST.
Cross-check
Industry/concept confirmation unavailable
Overnight/futures: SPY -0.58%, QQQ -1.07% and DIA -0.63% were delayed September 10 cash-session proxies with market timestamps around 08:00 CST and a 09:20 fetch; they were not live futures. Moomoo Industry, Futunn Sparks and the one allowed Moomoo Sparks fallback all returned HTTP 403. No rows were reused; confirmation/divergence/potential reversal cannot be classified.
A/H Mapping
Oil and rates matter more than the unavailable panels
The overnight chip selloff and higher oil/yields map to pressure on A/H growth, airlines and transport; only local intraday price and breadth can overturn that signal.

Intraday Conclusion

Fact: This is a delayed intraday update, not a pre-open forecast. At 09:47 CST the SSE Composite was down 1.62%; at 09:34 CST the Hang Seng was down 1.46%.

Judgment: Technology-finance and capital-market reform are medium-term supports, but oil, yields and the overnight chip retreat dominate the near-term risk signal.

Uncertainty: The September 11 AKShare refresh was unavailable and both US rankings were blocked. Local breadth and sector confirmation therefore remain unverified.

Stock Recommendations

Status note: these cards describe conditional states, not immediate buy instructions; every quote carries its latest verifiable timestamp.

GenScript BiotechHK.01548
Conditional Watch

Fact and status: the company placed 77.126 million shares at HK$30.50, raising about HK$2.327 billion net for AIDD capacity, R&D and general corporate uses. The latest verifiable Google Finance quote was HK$32.98, +3.06%, at 10:12:06 CST.

Confirmation: hold above the HK$30.50 placement price with sustained turnover and no relative weakening versus biotech.

Risk and invalidation: enlarged-share dilution is about 3.38%; a break below the placement price or persistent placement selling invalidates the watch.

CambriconSH.688256
Conditional Watch

Fact and status: Reuters reported domestic AI-accelerator price increases amid an HBM shortage. The latest verifiable Google Finance quote was CNY1,034.56, -0.89%, at 09:59:22 CST; that negative feedback is not bullish confirmation.

Confirmation: turn positive and outperform local chip peers while the supply-chain report receives further corroboration.

Risk and invalidation: the report relies on unnamed supply-chain sources, while HBM constraints can also raise input costs; broader weakness or failure to convert pricing into orders and margins invalidates the watch.

Sun Hung Kai PropertiesHK.00016
Avoid

Fact and status: FY2025/26 underlying profit was HK$22.850 billion, attributable profit HK$21.426 billion and full-year dividend HK$3.91, up 4%; however, the latest verifiable Google Finance quote was HK$113.20, -3.00%, at 09:20:13 CST.

Revisit condition: stabilize and reclaim the opening range with improving relative strength versus Hong Kong property peers.

Risk and invalidation: constructive earnings and dividend news met clear negative price feedback; continued underperformance must not be packaged as a bullish candidate.

Yue Yuen IndustrialHK.00551
Avoid

Fact and status: the filing showed August revenue down 2.1% year on year and January-August manufacturing revenue down 5.0%. No reliable September 11 quote was obtained; the latest accessible quote remained HK$13.09 at 16:08:42 CST on September 10.

Revisit condition: monthly revenue returns to year-on-year growth and subsequent reliable market data confirms demand.

Risk and invalidation: further revenue contraction invalidates a consumption/manufacturing recovery thesis; the missing same-day quote does not erase the negative operating evidence.

Sector Rotation

Relative beneficiary

Upstream oil and policy-backed financial infrastructure, subject to local price confirmation.

Watchlist

Technology finance, AI servers and capital-market services; wait for breadth and sustained volume.

Pressure

Semiconductors, airlines, transport and diluted HK names face oil, rate or financing pressure.

Verification

SSE/HSI breadth, chip relative strength, Brent, the US 10-year yield and post-open volume.

Logic Chain

Oil and geopolitical risk → higher inflation hurdle → pressure on growth, airlines and transport.
US chip weakness → A/H semiconductor mapping → require local relative strength before upgrading.
PBOC/CSRC reform → financing support and long-term capital → impact depends on credit and turnover transmission.
HK filings → company-specific catalysts and dilution → price feedback determines inclusion.

Risk Radar

Oil and geopolitics

Supply disruption or relief can rapidly reverse sector leadership.

Rates

A US 10-year yield near 5% raises the valuation hurdle for long-duration assets.

Negative price feedback

SHKP and GenScript opened lower despite apparently constructive headlines.

Evidence freshness

The latest AKShare file is dated September 10 and cannot represent September 11 breadth.

Ranking degradation

Both US ranking groups were blocked by HTTP 403 and no stale rows were substituted.

entries.summary: 道指、标普500和纳指100期货在美东6:58分别约涨0.55%、0.53%和0.60%；Brent回落3.21%至约104.18美元，10年期美债收益率仍约4.94%。ORCL财报后盘前涨约6%—7%，NVDA、RH与SOBO走强；ADBE、MKSI、AFG和KR只作风险观察。20:34 CST回读时BLS公开CPI当前版仍为7月，未用预期冒充实际值。

重大新闻汇总
市场
期指在连跌后反弹
Reuters在美东6:58核验：道指、标普500和纳指100期货分别约+0.55%、+0.53%和+0.60%。反弹仍处于CPI与高收益率双重检验前。
宏观
CPI到发布时间但公开实际值暂不可核验
BLS日历确认8月CPI于9月11日8:30 ET发布；20:34 CST回读时其当前公开页仍显示7月结果。因此不把0.4%月增、3.4%同比等市场预期写成实际值。
能源
油价回落但供应风险仍高
Brent约跌3.21%至104.18美元、WTI约跌2.89%至99.52美元，但两者周涨幅仍超过8%；霍尔木兹和红海运输风险未消。
利率
10年期收益率仍逼近5%
10年期美债收益率约4.94%—4.95%，接近2023年以来高位；长端利率继续限制高久期科技估值。
财报
ORCL业绩与云积压获正反馈
ORCL调整后EPS 1.92美元、营收约193亿美元，均高于预期；云基础设施收入同比增长121%至74亿美元，积压订单6640亿美元，盘前涨约6%—7%。
负反馈
ADBE财务beat仍遭抛售
ADBE营收67.6亿美元、调整后EPS 6.13美元均略超预期并小幅上调全年区间，但AI竞争、CEO交接和下一季指引担忧主导，盘前跌约3%—4%。
AI
NVDA获ORCL云需求读穿
ORCL的AI云基础设施增长强化服务器需求证据，NVDA盘前约涨0.8%；但10年期收益率接近5%限制估值扩张。
并购
ACVA涨约44%主要来自收购溢价
Copart同意以约19亿美元收购ACV Auctions；ACVA大涨属于交易套利观察，不作为基本面趋势推荐。CPRT盘前约涨6%，但仍需评估整合和交易执行。
消费
RH获正反馈，KR下调展望
RH利润好于预期后盘前约涨8.2%；Kroger虽EPS好于预期，却下调全年同店销售区间，盘前跌约1.5%—3%，显示必需消费也受压力。
芯片
MKSI重挫，半导体只见个股分化
MKSI盘前跌约8.7%，而NVDA约涨0.8%、MU约涨0.8%。负反馈标的不进入多头卡，芯片链需开盘后量价确认。

盘前结论

事实：油价虽回落但仍在100美元附近或上方，10年期美债收益率约4.94%；三大期指约涨0.5%—0.6%，属于高利率背景下的反弹。

判断：开盘基线偏向结构性修复，ORCL、NVDA、RH和部分中游能源更强；ADBE、MKSI、AFG与KR的负反馈优先于利好叙事。

不确定性：CPI公开实际值在核验时仍不可得，油价与地缘周末跳空风险较高；所有盘前推荐均须由开盘成交与相对强弱确认。

重点个股推荐

OracleORCL
财报正反馈

推荐理由：调整后盈利、营收和AI云增速均超预期，盘前约+6%—7%。

触发因素：开盘守住财报缺口并继续强于IGV与大盘。

风险点：资本开支、债务、客户集中度及可靠盘前成交量不可得。

NvidiaNVDA
AI读穿

推荐理由：ORCL云基础设施增长强化AI服务器需求，NVDA盘前约+0.8%。

触发因素：开盘继续强于QQQ和半导体基准，且成交扩张。

风险点：高估值、长债接近5%及盘前量能不可得。

RHRH
业绩强势

推荐理由：利润好于预期后盘前约+8.2%，价格明确确认财报。

触发因素：守住缺口并维持对可选消费板块的超额收益。

风险点：高端家具需求、利率敏感性和盘前量能不可得。

South BowSOBO
能源相对强势

推荐理由：在Brent回落时盘前仍约+9.6%，呈现独立相对强势。

触发因素：开盘后守住缺口且成交确认，不随油价继续回落转弱。

风险点：催化细节与可靠盘前量能不足，油价和地缘消息可快速反转。

板块轮动看板

强势观察

ORCL、NVDA、RH与SOBO；只保留开盘继续强于基准者。

事件驱动

ORCL/ADBE财报、CPRT收购ACVA、油价与CPI。

压力方向

高久期软件、部分芯片、零售与能源密集型行业；ADBE、MKSI、AFG、KR等待止跌。

验证信号

CPI公开实际值、10年期收益率、Brent、QQQ相对强弱及开盘成交。

逻辑链

宏观门槛

CPI实际值未可核验 + 10年期收益率约4.94% → 反弹的估值空间受限。

能源传导

Brent日内回落但周涨超8% → 短线通胀缓和与中期供应风险并存。

财报分化

ORCL获正反馈、ADBE遭负反馈 → AI主题必须用价格而非beat标题筛选。

开盘判断

若收益率不上破5%且期指守住涨幅，结构性修复延续；若CPI偏热或油价反弹，科技与消费先承压。

盘后财报 beat 概率

可验证盘后科技财报公司不足/无大型科技公司。 已检查Nasdaq与MarketWatch的2026年9月11日财报日历；截至20:34 CST未能取得带可核验一致预期、历史surprise与近期指引的大型科技盘后样本，因此不虚构公司或高/中/低概率。行业层面关注ORCL对AI基础设施需求的读穿，但缺少当日晚间具体公司样本。

风险雷达

CPI实际值不可核验

20:34 CST公开BLS当前页仍为7月，不以预期替代实际。

周末地缘跳空

霍尔木兹、红海与能源设施消息可在休市期间重定价。

长债接近5%

收益率若上破会提高股债再配置和成长股折现压力。

负反馈个股

ADBE、MKSI、AFG与KR等待止跌，不追多。

盘前量能缺口

推荐卡均未取得可靠成交量，开盘量价是强制确认。

数据来源与时间点

来源与时点：Reuters/LSEG期指、油价、利率、ORCL、Kroger及基金流向报道；美国劳工统计局2026发布日历、CPI当前页和PPI；Barron's/Dow Jones/FactSet盘前期货与个股；MarketWatch、WSJ与Investopedia盘前报道及财报日历；行情于2026-09-11 20:34 CST核验。Reuters报价至少延迟15分钟；CPI公开实际值尚不可得，盘前量能缺失处均已披露。

PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 indicate heat/importance, not price change.
Major News
Market
Futures rebound after a losing streak
Reuters checked Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures at about +0.55%, +0.53% and +0.60% at 6:58 a.m. ET. The rebound still faces the CPI and high-yield tests.
Macro
CPI reached release time but the public actual was not yet verifiable
The BLS calendar set August CPI for September 11 at 8:30 a.m. ET; at the 20:34 CST check, its public current page still showed July. Therefore forecasts such as +0.4% m/m and +3.4% y/y are not presented as actuals.
Energy
Oil retreats but supply risk remains high
Brent fell about 3.21% to $104.18 and WTI about 2.89% to $99.52, yet both remained up more than 8% for the week; Hormuz and Red Sea shipping risks persist.
Rates
The 10-year yield remains near 5%
The 10-year Treasury yield remained around 4.94%–4.95%, near its highest since 2023, continuing to constrain long-duration technology valuations.
Earnings
ORCL earnings and cloud backlog receive positive feedback
ORCL posted adjusted EPS of $1.92 and about $19.3 billion in revenue, both above expectations; cloud infrastructure revenue rose 121% to $7.4 billion and backlog reached $664 billion, sending shares up about 6%–7% premarket.
Negative
ADBE sells off despite a financial beat
ADBE's $6.76 billion revenue and $6.13 adjusted EPS slightly beat estimates and it nudged up its full-year range, but AI competition, the CEO transition and next-quarter guidance concerns dominated; shares fell about 3%–4% premarket.
AI
NVDA gains an ORCL cloud-demand read-through
ORCL's AI cloud infrastructure growth reinforced server-demand evidence and NVDA rose about 0.8% premarket, although a near-5% 10-year yield limits multiple expansion.
M&A
ACVA jumps about 44% mainly on a takeover premium
Copart agreed to acquire ACV Auctions for about $1.9 billion; ACVA's surge is a deal-arbitrage observation, not a fundamental trend recommendation. CPRT rose about 6% premarket, with integration and execution still to assess.
Consumer
RH receives positive feedback while KR cuts its outlook
RH rose about 8.2% premarket after profit beat expectations; Kroger beat on EPS but cut its full-year identical-sales range and fell about 1.5%–3%, showing pressure even in staples.
Chips
MKSI slumps as semiconductors show only selective strength
MKSI fell about 8.7% premarket while NVDA and MU each gained about 0.8%. The negative-feedback name is excluded from bullish cards, and the chip chain needs post-open price and volume confirmation.

Premarket Conclusion

Fact:Oil retreated but remained near or above $100 while the 10-year Treasury yield was about 4.94%; the three major futures rose roughly 0.5%–0.6%, a rebound inside a high-rate backdrop.

View:The opening baseline favors a selective repair, led by ORCL, NVDA, RH and parts of midstream energy; negative feedback in ADBE, MKSI, AFG and KR takes precedence over positive narratives.

Uncertainty:The public CPI actual was still unavailable at verification, while oil and geopolitical weekend-gap risks remain high; all premarket picks require confirmation from post-open volume and relative strength.

Stock Picks

OracleORCL
Earnings positive

Rationale: Adjusted earnings, revenue and AI cloud growth beat expectations, with shares up about 6%–7% premarket.

Trigger: Hold the earnings gap after the open and continue to outperform IGV and the broad market.

Risk: Capital spending, debt, customer concentration and unavailable reliable premarket volume.

NvidiaNVDA
AI read-through

Rationale: ORCL's cloud-infrastructure growth reinforces AI-server demand; NVDA rose about 0.8% premarket.

Trigger: Continue to outperform QQQ and the semiconductor benchmark after the open with expanding volume.

Risk: High valuation, a near-5% long yield and unavailable premarket volume.

RHRH
Earnings strength

Rationale: Shares rose about 8.2% premarket after profit beat expectations, clearly confirming the report.

Trigger: Hold the gap and maintain outperformance versus consumer discretionary.

Risk: Luxury furniture demand, rate sensitivity and unavailable premarket volume.

South BowSOBO
Energy relative strength

Rationale: Shares remained about +9.6% premarket even as Brent fell, showing independent relative strength.

Trigger: Hold the gap with confirmed volume after the open and avoid weakening with another oil decline.

Risk: Catalyst detail and reliable premarket volume are limited; oil and geopolitical headlines can reverse quickly.

Sector Rotation Board

Strength watch

ORCL, NVDA, RH and SOBO; retain only names that keep outperforming after the open.

Event-driven

ORCL/ADBE earnings, CPRT's ACVA deal, oil and CPI.

Pressure areas

Long-duration software, selected chips, retail and energy-intensive industries; wait for stabilization in ADBE, MKSI, AFG and KR.

Validation signals

Public CPI actual, the 10-year yield, Brent, QQQ relative strength and opening volume.

Logic Chain

Macro hurdle

CPI actual not yet verifiable + a roughly 4.94% 10-year yield → limited valuation room for the rebound.

Energy transmission

Brent falls on the day but gains more than 8% on the week → short-term inflation relief coexists with medium-term supply risk.

Earnings divergence

ORCL receives positive feedback while ADBE gets negative feedback → screen the AI theme by price, not beat headlines.

Opening call

If the yield stays below 5% and futures hold gains, selective repair can continue; a hot CPI or oil rebound would pressure technology and consumers first.

After-hours Earnings Beat Probability

Insufficient verifiable after-hours technology earnings / no large technology company. Nasdaq and MarketWatch earnings calendars for September 11, 2026 were checked. As of 20:34 CST, no large after-hours technology sample with verifiable consensus, historical surprises and recent guidance was available, so no company or high/medium/low probability is fabricated. The sector view watches ORCL's AI-infrastructure demand read-through, but no specific company sample is available for the evening.

Risk Radar

CPI actual unavailable

At 20:34 CST the public BLS current page still showed July; forecasts are not treated as actuals.

Weekend geopolitical gap

Hormuz, Red Sea and energy-facility headlines can reprice markets while closed.

Long yield near 5%

A break higher would raise equity-to-bond rotation and growth-stock discount-rate pressure.

Negative-feedback names

Wait for stabilization in ADBE, MKSI, AFG and KR; do not chase longs.

Premarket volume gap

Reliable premarket volume was unavailable for the picks; post-open price and volume are mandatory confirmation.

Sources and Timestamp

Sources and timestamp: Reuters/LSEG futures, oil, rates, ORCL, Kroger and fund-flow coverage; the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics 2026 calendar, current CPI page and PPI; Barron's/Dow Jones/FactSet premarket futures and movers; MarketWatch, WSJ and Investopedia premarket coverage and earnings calendars. Data were checked at 2026-09-11 20:34 CST. Reuters quotes are delayed by at least 15 minutes; the public CPI actual was not yet available, and missing premarket volume is disclosed.
